scope: Raw evidence, source ancestry, compile/upload receipts, runtime protocol; external trace alignment/energy and independent machine-code call audit are separate. No new physical experiment is performed by this script.
limitations: Two recorded acquisitions per model on one board; second acquisition follows rearm in the same boot and is not a fresh flash or independent device.
20 prepared rows are cycled; count is inference calls, not unique network flows.
compiled_C_predictions is a software consistency reference, not an accuracy estimate on a held-out IDS dataset.
Application serial transport is quiet during acquisition; esp_timer timestamps, not host USB arrival times, define batch duration.
The firmware policy supports temporary IDLE0 watchdog removal, but actual all-ten logs report idle_before=0, loop_before=0 and suspended=0: no task subscription was removed.
Build-reported static RAM is not measured peak RAM. Model bytes are not firmware program or .bin file size.
